# DOPEY CI operational subset - curated, deterministic, and network-free test files.
#
# Why a curated subset (not the full suite):
#   The full suite currently collects 3,535 tests across its isolated eight-shard
#   execution plan and is intentionally heavy -
#   DOPEY_TEST_SHARD_PLAN.md records full_suite_status: inconclusive_timeout with
#   a recommended_long_timeout_seconds: 900. Many files drive real pipeline engines
#   (signal/backtest/supervisor) that take tens of seconds each, and several spawn
#   subprocesses or exercise environment-specific paths that are not appropriate for
#   GitHub-hosted runners. The shard plan's own "Split Suite Commands" hardcode a
#   local Windows venv path (C:\Users\CH\dopey\.venv\...) and cannot run in CI.
#
# This manifest is the CI-portable fallback the plan calls for: an explicit allowlist
# of deterministic operational and pure-logic test files (900+ test cases). A
# canonical content-addressed modulo plan assigns each path across the job matrix
# without depending on line order or moving existing paths when a new one is added.
# The workflow enforces an 800-test collection
# floor, exact file coverage, and unique node-ID coverage so future edits cannot
# silently narrow or duplicate the gate.
#
# Lines beginning with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
